藏品名称_EN: motorola mbp26 digital video baby monitor
藏品名称_ZN: 摩托罗拉mbp26数字视频婴儿监视器
描述_EN: on another thread, the development of these products raises questions of whether these sorts of expensive product are really strictly necessary outside of the medical environment, and whether they ease or heighten the anxieties of parents. the motorola mbp26 consists of two parts: a mains-powered digital video camera and a battery-powered handheld ‘parent unit’. the camera is able to remotely pan and tilt, so parents can try to find better views of their child without disturbing it. its product literature claims it is effective at a distance of up to 300m. it is equipped with infra-red night vision, a high-sensitivity microphone and two-way communication. objects such as these reveal much about the anxiety of new parents when caring for very young children, and how manufacturers create products in response to this anxiety which are designed to ease parents’ fears.
描述_ZN: 从另一个角度看，这些产品的开发提出了这样的问题：在医疗环境之外，这些昂贵的产品是否真的严格必要，以及它们是缓解还是加剧了父母的焦虑。 摩托罗拉mbp26由两部分组成：一个由电源供电的数字视频摄像机和一个由电池供电的手持式 "父单元"。 摄像头能够远程平移和倾斜，因此父母可以尝试在不打扰孩子的情况下找到更好的视角。 它的产品资料声称它在300米的距离上是有效的。 它配备了红外线夜视仪，一个高灵敏度的麦克风和双向通信。 诸如此类的物品揭示了许多关于新父母在照顾年幼孩子时的焦虑，以及制造商如何针对这种焦虑创造产品，以缓解父母的恐惧。
